subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open conflicting cross-repo PR and allow a new narrow fix against the active Telegram approval runtime?
rationale: The code fix shape is clear, but an open cross-repo closing PR still claims the issue while being conflicting, uneditable by maintainers, and aimed at the removed handler path.

options.title: Close and replace the fork PR
options.body: Close or decline the conflicting cross-repo candidate, then allow a narrow same-repo fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork work manually
options.body: A maintainer can port only the useful intent from the fork PR into the active runtime path and discard the stale docs and removed-handler changes.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the open fork PR, accepting that the current branch is conflicting, stale, and not maintainer-modifiable.

recommendation.title: Close and replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Close or decline the conflicting cross-repo candidate, then allow a narrow same-repo fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and merge history make this the best available routing owner for deciding whether to replace the conflicting candidate.
